mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_payment_history (event_type, event_source, old_status, new_status, amount, description, payment_key, user_code, created_at) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{eventSource}, #{oldStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{amount}, #{description}, #{paymentKey}, #{userCode}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select:
SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName,
pAgg.paymentKey, pAgg.hanFee, pAgg.bookFee, pAgg.hanMaterial, pAgg.bookMaterial, pAgg.totalPrice, pAgg.totalFee, pAgg.totalMaterialFee, pAgg.totalStatus, pAgg.unpaidAmount,
hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher,
(a.parent_tel_first + a.parent_tel_middle + a.parent_tel_last) AS parentPhone,
subj.subject, bill.eduStatus, bill.materialStatus,
bill.billId
FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_parent a ON s.student_id = a.student_id
JOIN ( SELECT p.student_id, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, p.status AS totalStatus, p.unpaid_amount AS unpaidAmount,
MAX(CASE WHEN d.class_type = 1 AND d.item_type = 'edu_fee' THEN d.amount END) AS hanFee, MAX(CASE WHEN d.class_type = 2 AND d.item_type = 'edu_fee' THEN d.amount END) AS bookFee, MAX(CASE WHEN d.class_type = 1 AND d.item_type = 'book_fee' THEN d.amount END) AS hanMaterial, MAX(CASE WHEN d.class_type = 2 AND d.item_type = 'book_fee' THEN d.amount END) AS bookMaterial,
MAX(CASE WHEN d.class_type = 1 THEN d.user_code END) AS hanUserCode, MAX(CASE WHEN d.class_type = 2 THEN d.user_code END) AS bookUserCode,
SUM(d.amount) AS totalPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN d.item_type = 'edu_fee' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS totalFee, SUM(CASE WHEN d.item_type = 'book_fee' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS totalMaterialFee
FROM erp_payment p JOIN erp_payment_detail d ON p.payment_key = d.payment_key WHERE p.yy = #{year} AND p.mm = #{month} GROUP BY p.student_id, p.payment_key, p.status, p.unpaid_amount ) pAgg ON pAgg.student_id = s.student_id
LEFT JOIN erp_user hu ON pAgg.hanUserCode = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu ON pAgg.bookUserCode = bu.user_code
OUTER APPLY ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN pb.bill_type = 'edu' THEN pb.status END) AS eduStatus, MAX(CASE WHEN pb.bill_type = 'material' THEN pb.status END) AS materialStatus, MAX(pb.bill_id) AS billId FROM erp_payment_bill pb WHERE pb.payment_key = pAgg.paymentKey ) bill
OUTER APPLY ( SELECT STUFF(( SELECT ', ' + c.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code c ON c.class_key = CASE WHEN t.class_key = 'COM' THEN ta.class_key ELSE t.class_key END WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND c.class_type IN (1,2) AND t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month}
AND t.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS subject ) subj
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_user u ON t.user_code = u.user_code WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} AND u.center_code = #{centerCode}
AND t.user_code = #{userCode}
)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_payment (payment_key, amount, method, status, yy, mm, student_id, center_code, created_at) VALUES (#{paymentKey}, #{amount}, #{method}, #{status}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{student.studentId}, #{center.centerCode}, SYSDATETIME())

INSERT INTO erp_payment_detail (payment_key, amount, class_type, item_type, time_table_key, user_code, created_at) VALUES (#{payment.paymentKey}, #{amount}, #{classType}, #{itemType}, #{timeTableKey}, #{user.userCode}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_payment SET amount = detail.total_amount, unpaid_amount = detail.total_amount FROM (SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM erp_payment_detail WHERE payment_key = #{paymentKey}) AS detail WHERE payment_key = #{paymentKey};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_payment_bill (bill_id, amount, status, bill_type, expire_date, issued_date, payment_key, student_id, center_code, yy, mm, created_At) VALUES (#{billId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{billType}, #{expireDate}, #{issuedDate}, #{payment.paymentKey}, #{student.studentId}, #{center.centerCode}, #{yy}, #{mm}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_payment SET status = 'issued', updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE payment_key = #{paymentKey}
UPDATE erp_payment_bill SET status = #{status}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE bill_id = #{billId}
UPDATE erp_payment SET status = #{newStatus}, paid_date = #{paidDate}, unpaid_amount = #{unpaidAmount}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE payment_key = #{paymentKey}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE payment_key = #{paymentKey} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_payment_callback (bill_id, api_key, appr_state, appr_date, appr_price, appr_pay_type, appr_card_type, appr_issuer, appr_num, created_at) VALUES (#{paymentBill.billId}, #{apiKey}, #{apprState}, #{apprDate}, #{apprPrice}, #{apprPayType}, #{apprCardType}, #{apprIssuer}, #{apprNum}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM erp_payment p JOIN erp_payment_bill b ON p.payment_key = b.payment_key WHERE b.bill_id = #{billId}

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, g.grade_name AS gradeName, hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher FROM erp_payment p JOIN erp_student s ON p.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_user hu ON ta.assign_han_teacher = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu ON ta.assign_book_teacher = bu.user_code where p.status = 'issued' AND p.center_code = #{centerCode} AND (hu.user_code = #{userCode} OR bu.user_code = #{userCode})
